description: Find points of interest near a city or coordinates using Votura. Optionally filter by category (e.g. "museum", "castle", "park"). Returns place names, addresses, ratings, coordinates, and a link to Votura audio tours of the surrounding city.

category.description: Type of place to filter by — English singular or plural, e.g. "castle", "museum", "park", "church", "brewery", "cemetery", "landmark", "restaurant"

city.description: City or place name to search near, e.g. "Amsterdam", "Kyoto"

latitude.description: Latitude — provide instead of city if you have coordinates

longitude.description: Longitude — provide instead of city if you have coordinates

name: search_places
title: Search Places
